name: Universal Solar, LLC
old_description: Stable electricity is one of the most recurrent problems of rural areas. At Universal Solar, LLC, we want to help our customers to enjoy power even when there are blackouts. We’re a solar company serving in Millersburg, PA, with almost a decade of experience in the industry. We take pride in providing our customers with energy-efficient solutions for their properties. If you’re looking for a trusted solar company in Millersburg, PA, you’re in the right place!
about:
Universal Solar, LLC is a solar installation and service company based in Millersburg, Pennsylvania. The company has been operating for nearly a decade, focusing on energy-efficient solutions for rural areas prone to blackouts. The business is operated by Elmer, who is frequently cited in customer reviews for his hands-on expertise and responsiveness.

The company designs and installs off-grid, grid-tied, and grid-interactive solar systems for residential, commercial, and industrial clients. Its service portfolio includes solar panel installation and repair, battery storage solutions, system maintenance and inspection, and well pump installations. Universal Solar serves a multi-county region in central and northeastern Pennsylvania, including Millersburg, Bloomsburg, Lewisburg, Williamsport, and Scranton.

Customers range from homeowners seeking backup power to businesses and industrial facilities aiming to lower energy costs. Commercial projects include roof-mounted arrays for businesses, while industrial installations target facility-scale energy production. The company also addresses agricultural and rural needs with off-grid systems and solar-powered well pumps.

Universal Solar was motivated by the vulnerability of the electrical grid and aims to help customers achieve energy independence. The company offers free estimates and financing options to reduce upfront costs.

name: Uptown Millworks
old_description: Uptown Millworks is a New Orleans millwork shop and furniture maker specializing in quality, style and function. We work to make a comfortable, personal environment from every client's needs. The finishing touch of beauty and personality for any room.
about:
Uptown Millworks operates from the Uptown neighborhood of New Orleans, Louisiana, as a locally owned and operated custom millwork shop. The company was founded by Christian Pokorn, who comes from a multi‑generational woodworking family in Austria and spent summers in his family’s sawmill. After building a career in construction as the principal of Pokorn Construction, Pokorn established Uptown Millworks to focus on custom architectural millwork and historically faithful restoration for New Orleans homes.

The shop produces a full range of millwork and furniture, including handrails, flooring, cypress slabs, custom cabinets, moldings, windows, doors, shutters, and turnings. Using time‑tested woodworking techniques alongside modern precision tools, the team of millwrights, carpenters, and woodworkers fabricates every piece in their New Orleans workshop. Materials are purchased per project rather than stocked, minimizing waste, and all finishing and assembly occur on site.

Uptown Millworks serves residential, hospitality, and commercial clients across Louisiana, with projects in private homes, restaurants, hotels, and historic buildings. The company coordinates directly with customers and vendors on architectural millwork, casework, and restoration work that meets the standards of the Architectural Woodwork Institute, the Forest Stewardship Council, and the NOLA Historic District Landmarks Commission.

Pokorn emphasizes building with honor and integrity, describing quality as the company’s entire philosophy. The operation prioritizes local manufacturing to create jobs, sources FSC‑certified and sustainable woods, and delivers finished pieces with its own crew to keep the carbon footprint low. Offcuts and sawdust are repurposed in the shop or donated to community gardens and animal shelters, reflecting a commitment to resource stewardship.

Services include product development, fashion and technical design, fabric and trim sourcing, pattern making, grading, marker making, sampling, cutting and sewing, screen printing, sublimation, heat transfer, finishing, packaging and inspection. Production is split by origin: luxury clothing in Italy, knitwear and basics in Peru, and specialty technical apparel in the USA. about:
Urth Apparel Inc. is a custom apparel manufacturer based in Newport Beach, California. Founded in 2013, the company began as an international trade cooperative focused on natural foods and cotton apparel from Peru. The founder started the venture after struggling to find a factory that shared a passion for fashionable products beyond basic tees and cared for the environment and workers.

The company provides end-to-end product development and manufacturing services, including fashion and technical design, fabric and trim sourcing, pattern making, grading, marker making, sampling, cutting and sewing, screen printing, sublimation, heat transfer, finishing, packaging, and inspection. Production is split across three origins: luxury clothing in Italy, knitwear and basics in Peru, and specialty technical apparel in the USA. Urth Apparel runs dedicated production lines for tees, tanks, and polos, and emphasizes sustainable and organic materials. The team consists of three employees at the Newport Beach headquarters, coordinating with overseas factories.

Urth Apparel serves clothing brands of all sizes, from startups to established labels, across categories such as tees and tanks, dresses, kids and baby apparel, yoga and athleisure wear, swimwear, and dress shirts. The company works with brands seeking a one-stop partner for concept-to-market apparel production, offering daily communication between design teams in the USA and Europe and production floors abroad.

The founders created Urth Apparel because they were unhappy with existing manufacturing partners that delivered non-uniform quality, poor business practices, and high minimums. Their philosophy centers on doing it right: taking care of the planet, taking care of workers, and creating clothing that lasts. The company positions itself as an ethical clothing factory that makes sustainable manufacturing easy for brands.

name: Utah Breakers & Supply
old_description: Utah Breakers & Supply was established in Salt Lake City, Utah in May of 2003 in a 6,000 square foot building.   In order to accommodate our continual growth in our inventory levels of electrical supplies we have recently relocated to a 12,000 square foot warehouse.
about:
Utah Breakers & Supply was established in May 2003 in Salt Lake City, Utah, starting in a 6,000-square-foot building. The company has since relocated to a 12,000-square-foot warehouse to accommodate growing inventory levels.

The firm buys and sells new, used, obsolete, and hard-to-find electrical equipment, with a focus on circuit breakers, hardware kits, transformers, safety switches, bus plugs, MCC buckets, and starters. It operates a reconditioning and refurbishing program that adheres to manufacturer specifications, using load-testing equipment to verify performance. All refurbished products carry a one-year warranty.

The company serves industrial and commercial customers requiring replacement or obsolete electrical components, including maintenance departments, electrical contractors, and facility operators. Its inventory targets applications where quick access to specific breakers or transformers is critical.

Utah Breakers emphasizes same-day shipping on stocked items, a one-year warranty on all products, and a strict reconditioning process designed to meet original manufacturer standards. The business was founded to address the difficulty of sourcing obsolete and hard-to-find electrical gear.

name: Utah Mountain Furniture
old_description: Our new line of in-house furniture that has been created specifically for our direct buy customers. If you are looking for beautiful, unique furniture at great pricing Click the link below.  You will only find this line of furniture here, please call us if you have any questions.
about:
Utah Mountain Furniture operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, producing a range of solid-wood furniture lines sold directly to buyers. The company does not disclose a founding year or founder names in its public materials, and no ownership designation such as family- or veteran-owned is indicated.

The shop builds several distinct collections: Aspen, crafted from eco-friendly dead-standing aspen logs; Barnwood, made from reclaimed barn wood, chicken coops, and snow fencing; Rocky Mountain, using smaller rustic logs with optional wildlife carvings and twig handles; Slimline, a space-saving series; and Salt River Rustic, a newer in-house line. A custom program allows clients to specify dimensions, stains, tiles, and carvings. Pieces are handcrafted on-site, and the company highlights a lacquer finish on its solid-wood bathroom furniture.

The furniture targets residential customers furnishing homes and cabins, as well as commercial spaces such as lodges or hospitality venues. Sales are direct to the end user through the company's website.

The business positions itself as a source for unique, one-of-a-kind pieces not available elsewhere, emphasizing the natural character of reclaimed and standing-dead timber and the ability to tailor each build to a customer's vision.

name: Utility Wire Products
old_description: Utility Wire Products, Inc. specializes in Point of Purchase Display Racks. We can produce a rack from your design, or work with you to develop a design, anything from a single display rack to meet a one product display need or a whole group to fill up a Plan-O-Gram for your product line.
about:
Utility Wire Products, Inc. operates from a 48,000-square-foot facility on Cleveland's industrial East Side, at 3302 East 87th Street. The company was founded in 1953 by Ed Peck and Bill Milavac. Donald Anzells purchased the business in 1980 and has led it as a family-owned, trans-generational operation; his son Ronald Anzells serves as president after 30 years with the firm, and Ronald Anzells Jr. joined in 2007 as plant manager and custom tooling specialist.

The shop specializes in custom wire forming across five major product lines: point-of-purchase display racks, wire guards for lighting, fans, machinery and heaters, wire baskets, wire forms, and grids. It works wire diameters from .080 to .500 inch in bright basic, stainless steel, and galvanized wire, and incorporates tubing, sheet metal, and plastics. An on-site 3D CNC bending machine supports both prototyping and production runs of 1 to 500,000 units. Finishing options include powder coating, vinyl, nylon, and various platings.

Customers span retail chains needing plan-o-gram display systems, industrial OEMs requiring protective guards, medical facilities using baskets for hospital stretchers, and manufacturers sourcing wire forms for screw-machine parts. The company accepts orders as small as a single unit and scales to high-volume production.

The firm's stated philosophy is to deliver a "Quality Product in a Timely Fashion at a Fair Price that are American made," treating every order — whether one piece or half a million — with equal importance and personal attention.

name: V-Tron Electronics Corporation
old_description: Manufacturers of High-Quality Assemblies, Wire Harnesses, Box Build, and Fiber Optic Assemblies
about:
V-Tron Electronics Corporation, based in Attleboro, Massachusetts, was incorporated in 1970 as a privately held, veteran-owned small business. The company began as an electronics service provider to the emerging Massachusetts computer industry in the 1970s before expanding into semiconductors, medical, military, and industrial electronics. President Doug Gobin emphasizes that quality and reliability are keys to survival in a competitive market.

The company manufactures custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, fiber optic assemblies, molded connector assemblies, and box build integrations in a 45,000-square-foot facility. Processes include low- and high-pressure molding with PVC, polyurethane, polypropylene, TPE, and TPA; fiber optic termination; and full box build with sheet metal chassis. V-Tron handles low to high volume order lot sizes, using a real-time bar-coded ERP system to track jobs from order inception through final inspection. Every assembly undergoes 100% functional testing, with Cirris 4250 scanners automating electrical tests on cables and harnesses.

V-Tron serves defense and security, military, life sciences, medical, semiconductor, and industrial electronics customers. Its assemblies are built to IPC standards in an ISO 9001:2015 environment, with UL and cUL recognition (E76510, E173242) and CSA certification (LR56498-1). The in-house training program, led by an IPC-certified instructor, ensures associates meet J-STD-001, IPC-A-610, and IPC/WHMA-A-620 workmanship requirements.

Founded on the principle that quality cannot be inspected into a product, V-Tron differentiates itself through reverse engineering and pre-production manufacturability analysis, a functional guarantee on every harness, and a culture of continuous improvement driven by its quality management system.

name: VIP (Vermont Information Processing)
old_description: VIP connects beverage industry suppliers, distributors, and retailers with purpose-built technology that simplifies complexity, strengthens relationships, and empowers smarter decisions across the entire ecosystem.
about:
Based in Colchester, Vermont, VIP (Vermont Information Processing) has spent more than five decades building software for the three-tier beverage ecosystem. The company operates under the VIP Insights brand and serves customers across all 50 states from its Vermont headquarters.

VIP provides a cloud-based platform that connects beverage suppliers, distributors, and retailers through integrated modules for routing and logistics, route accounting, ecommerce, reporting, and analytics.

The platform is used by suppliers seeking visibility into distributor performance, by distributors managing multi-stop delivery routes and inventory, and by retailers automating shelf replenishment and order placement. VIP's acquisition of Encompass Technologies expanded its footprint in the supplier segment.

VIP emphasizes that its technology is purpose-built for beverage rather than adapted from generic ERP systems, leveraging decades of industry data to train AI models that reason about beverage-specific workflows such as case-equivalent conversions, deposit management, and regulatory compliance.

name: VIP plastics and rubber manufacturing
old_description: Vip Rubber and Plastic is one of the best rubber and plastic manufacturing facilities in America. We specialize in custom rubber extrusions, plastic extrusions, rubber sheet products, molded rubber products, plastic pipe and tubing. We have been manufacturing high-quality parts in the USA since 1961.
about:
Vip Rubber and Plastic operates from Minden, Nevada, where it has been manufacturing rubber and plastic products since 1961. The company was founded by Howard Vipperman Sr., known as “Big Vip,” who entered the rubber industry as a gasket cutter after serving in the armed forces. It remains a family-owned business led by subsequent generations.

The facility produces custom and standard rubber extrusions, rubber sheet and rolls, molded rubber parts, and custom rubber compounds. On the plastic side, it runs plastic extrusion lines for profiles, pipe, tubing, vinyl spline, and window and door seals. A merger with Excalibur Extrusions expanded its plastic extrusion capacity. The company also offers value-added fabrication under its Vip+ Services banner, positioning itself as a one-stop shop.

Its customer base spans agriculture, aerospace, automotive, architectural glass and metal, and construction. The aerospace segment includes approvals to several Boeing material specifications, and the quality system holds AS9100 certification. The company notes it has produced parts for virtually every industry over its history.

Vip Rubber and Plastic emphasizes honesty and integrity as core values, and highlights its domestic manufacturing—all products are made in the USA. The founder’s hands-on experience on the shop floor is cited as the foundation for the company’s technical depth and long-term customer relationships.
